tools.description: Empties the request log of this test server. Use it before a new measurement; do not use it while one is running.
tools.name: clear_log

tools.description: Returns the fixed status text of this test server. Use it to see that the server is up; do not use it to change anything.
tools.name: get_status

tools.description: Sets the request counter of this test server back to zero. Use it to start a count over; do not use it to read the count.
tools.name: reset_counter
